title: Compute predicted indentation modulus from scaling model
action: Implement the provided scaling law for indentation modulus as a function of CNT volume fraction, using the given inter-CNT spacing values and baseline modulus, and compute the predicted modulus E for Vf = 1%, 10%, 20% at a minimum inter-CNT spacing of 5 nm.
description: Predicted indentation modulus values from the scaling model for three CNT volume fractions.
output_schema: CSV with header 'Vf' (percent) and 'predicted_E' (MPa). One row for each volume fraction: 1, 10, 20.
